internal_literal_asset_paths.scope: Literal quoted/Markdown publication paths in copied interface source; source-code filesystem paths in manifests are not treated as browser links. Compiled site/routing and dynamic interpolation are separate frontend tests.

crime_aggregate_reconciliation.note: Checks exported safe aggregates only; the original full source-freshness verifier also requires separately retained NOAA/DOJ raw files and prior expansion inputs.

privacy_review.disposition: No personal user path, secret token, private email, record identifier or individual street-address field found in the allowlisted textual/CSV files. The two lexical candidates are a generic C:/Windows/Fonts dependency and literal drive-prefix examples used by the private-source safety checker. Neither identifies the user or exposes a credential. Source original PDFs are intentionally outside the aggregate archive.
